references.text: Describes the basic signs of leprosy in the skin, including white or reddish spots, which the priest is to examine.
The priest examines the sore on the skin to determine if it is leprosy, following the same procedure as in verse 43.
Describes white swellings with a reddish color as signs of leprosy, the same symptoms mentioned in verse 43.
The immediate context dealing with baldness and spots on the head, which verse 43 continues to describe.
Summarizes the laws concerning leprosy, including swellings and spots, as a comprehensive teaching about the disease.
Refers to the priests' role in handling leprosy according to the Levitical laws.
